title: 【明治時代】208 明治時代はどのように始まったのか？【日本史】
description: A university-entrance-exam-level Japanese history lesson covering the beginning of the Meiji era. Explains the fall of the Tokugawa shogunate (徳川幕府の衰退), the Boshin War (戊辰戦争), and the establishment of the Meiji government. Uses slide-based presentation with heavy on-screen Japanese text and clear narration at a natural but accessible pace. Covers formal historical vocabulary and concepts essential for N2 and JLPT History reading.
creator: YouTube高校 (Japanese History Channel)
